description: DeepSeek brain + automatic image transcription for DeepSeek Harness: a deepseek-vision provider route that transcribes attached images to text via any OpenAI-compatible VLM before delegating to the text-only DeepSeek adapter. Paid fast path with a key (DashScope/Zhipu/OpenRouter...), zero-config local Ollama auto-detection, and no hangs — anonymous endpoints are capped at 20s and fail fast with guidance.
